title.en: How Nepali diaspora is responding to flood disaster and how Australians can help in relief effort
title.zh: 尼泊尔侨民如何应对洪水灾难以及澳大利亚人如何帮助救灾

summary.en: Nepali and Tibetan communities in Australia are planning vigils and fundraising events to support recovery efforts following a devastating flood and landslide disaster in Nepal and Tibet. The death toll has risen to 579, with over 1,900 people missing as communities anxiously await news of loved ones.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的尼泊尔和藏族社区正在计划守夜和筹款活动，以支持在尼泊尔和西藏发生毁灭性洪水和山体滑坡灾难后的恢复工作。随着社区焦急地等待亲人的消息，死亡人数已升至579人，失踪人数超过1900人。

body.en: Nepali and Tibetan communities plan vigils and work to raise funds for recovery in ‘devastating’ time Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s Nepali community plan to host vigils to remember the victims of the Nepal-Tibet flood disaster to coincide with a day of mourning, as the number of people killed continues to rise. As Australia’s Nepali diaspora wait for the full scale of the disaster to become clear, community members are desperately waiting to hear from missing relatives and friends. Nepali authorities said on Friday that the death toll had risen to 579, with the number missing rising sharply to more than 1,900, after massive flash floods and landslides tore through the Bhotekoshi and Trishuli river basins on Wednesday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏社区计划举行守夜活动，并努力为“灾难性”时期的恢复筹集资金 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚尼泊尔社区计划在哀悼日期间举办守夜活动，以纪念尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾害的受害者，因为死亡人数持续上升。当澳大利亚的尼泊尔侨民等待灾难的全面真相明朗之际，社区成员正在拼命等待失踪亲友的消息。尼泊尔当局周五表示，周三博特科希河和特里苏利河流域发生大规模山洪和山体滑坡，死亡人数已上升至 579 人，失踪人数急剧上升至 1,900 多人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, the Nepali and Tibetan diaspora in Australia are stepping up. They are organizing vigils to honor the lost and fundraising to aid recovery, embodying the principle of speaking up for those who cannot speak for themselves. This community action, reaching across continents, reflects a profound commitment...
reflection.zh: 面对尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性洪水，澳大利亚的尼泊尔和藏族侨民正在挺身而出。他们正在组织守夜活动以纪念逝者，并筹集资金以援助灾后重建，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人发声的原则。 这种跨越大陆的社区行动，反映了对祖国的深切承诺以及对弱势群体的关怀，表明同情心不分国界。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How is One Nation influencing Labor’s immigration policy? – Back to Back Barries podcast
title.zh: 一国党如何影响工党的移民政策？

summary.en: Tony Barry and Sean Kelly discuss the politics of immigration and asylum following contradictory policy statements from Labor and One Nation this week. They examine the extent to which Labor is being influenced by One Nation and whether the government is sufficiently advocating for immigration. The discussion also...
summary.zh: 托尼·巴里和肖恩·凯利讨论了本周工党和一国党在移民和庇护政策上发表矛盾声明后的政治影响。他们探讨了工党在多大程度上受到一国党的影响，以及政府是否充分为移民政策进行辩护。讨论还涉及政府在消费税和数据中心可再生能源方面对各州的让步，以及随着新的通胀数据预示着未来可能加息，工党面临的严峻经济前景。

body.en: Tony Barry and Sean Kelly , sitting in for Barrie Cassidy, examine the politics of immigration and asylum after contradictory policy statements this week from Labor and One Nation . They discuss how much Labor is being led by One Nation and whether the government is doing enough to make the case for immigration. They also cover the concessions made by the Albanese government to the states on GST and renewable energy for datacentres, as well as the bumpy economic road ahead for Labor, with new inflation numbers suggesting interest rates hikes in the future Continue reading...
body.zh: 托尼·巴里 (Tony Barry) 和肖恩·凯利 (Sean Kelly) 代替巴里·卡西迪 (Barrie Cassidy)，在本周工党和一国党发表相互矛盾的政策声明后，审视移民和庇护政治。他们讨论了工党在多大程度上是由一国党领导的，以及政府是否采取了足够的措施来支持移民。它们还涵盖了阿尔巴尼亚政府在商品及服务税和数据中心可再生能源方面向各州做出的让步，以及工党未来坎坷的经济道路，新的通胀数据表明未来将加息继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political discourse often involves navigating competing interests and ideologies. When policy statements become contradictory, as seen with Labor and One Nation on immigration, it raises questions about the wisdom guiding leadership. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that in the multitude of counselors, there is safety, suggesting that thoughtful deliberation and...
reflection.zh: 政治论述常常涉及在相互竞争的利益和意识形态之间进行权衡。当政策声明出现矛盾时，正如在移民问题上工党和一国党所见，这会引发对指导领导层的智慧的疑问。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们，谋士众多，所谋就成，这表明深思熟虑和多元化的意见对于健全的治理至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Three boys crawled into a skip bin one night and by morning one was dead. How did it happen?
title.zh: 三个男孩爬进一个垃圾箱，到了早上，其中一人死了。这是怎么发生的？

summary.en: A coronial inquest is examining the death of Indigenous 13-year-old Budda Spencer, who had for years been on the radar of South Australian police and child protection. On a cold night five years ago, three boys crawled into an industrial skip bin, pulled cardboard over themselves to keep warm, and fell asleep. They...
summary.zh: 一项验尸调查正在审查13岁的原住民男孩巴达·斯宾塞（Budda...

body.en: A coronial inquest is examining the death of Indigenous 13-year-old Budda Spencer, who had for years been on the radar of South Australian police and child protection Warning: This article contains the name and image of an Indigenous person who has died On a cold night five years ago, three boys crawled into an industrial skip bin, pulled cardboard over themselves to keep warm, and – though they planned to stay awake – fell asleep. They woke as a rubbish truck hoisted the bin and poured its contents – including those three friends – into the storage section. One boy clambered out before the lid closed. Another stayed low. The third, whose family want him to be known as Budda Spencer, tried to escape but was injured in the fall, then crushed as the lid automatically closed. He died at the scene. Continue reading...
body.zh: 验尸调查正在调查 13 岁原住民布达·斯宾塞 (Budda Spencer) 的死亡情况，他多年来一直受到南澳大利亚警方和儿童保护机构的关注。 警告：本文包含一名已故原住民的姓名和照片。五年前的一个寒冷的夜晚，三个男孩爬进一个工业垃圾箱，用纸板盖住自己取暖，然后——尽管他们打算保持清醒——睡着了。当他们醒来时，一辆垃圾车升起了垃圾箱，并将里面的东西——包括那三个朋友——倒进了储藏室。盖子合上之前，一个男孩爬了出来。另一个则保持低位。第三个人的家人希望他被称为布达·斯宾塞(Budda Spencer)，他试图逃跑，但在坠落中受伤，然后随着盖子自动关闭而被压碎。他当场死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic death of 13-year-old Budda Spencer, who sought warmth in a skip bin and perished when it was emptied, speaks to a profound failure in protecting vulnerable youth. The story prompts us to consider how society cares for its most marginalized children, urging us to advocate for those who cannot speak for themselves.
reflection.zh: 13岁的巴达·斯宾塞（Budda Spencer）为了取暖而爬进垃圾箱，却在垃圾箱被清空时不幸身亡，他的悲惨离世揭示了保护弱势青少年的系统性失职。这个故事促使我们反思社会如何关怀最边缘化的儿童，并呼吁我们为那些无法为自己发声的人提供支持。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Hannah Ferguson: ‘I’m not Zohran Mamdani, I’m not that cool. But that’s the bar I want to set’
title.zh: 汉娜·弗格森：“我不如佐兰·马姆达尼那么酷。但这就是我想设定的标准”

summary.en: Hannah Ferguson, under 30, has authored two books, established a progressive media company, and aims to unseat the current prime minister. The article follows her as she discusses her parliamentary aspirations in Sydney's inner-west, even after encountering an older couple who, while liking her, disagreed with her...
summary.zh: 汉娜·弗格森（Hannah Ferguson）不到30岁，已出版两本书，创办了一家进步媒体公司，并立志要取代现任总理。文章讲述了她在悉尼内西区讨论竞选议员的计划，即使在遇到一对虽然喜欢她但却反对她政治抱负的老夫妇之后。

body.en: She’s written two books, launched a progressive media firm and plans to dethrone the prime minister – all before she turns 30. What is she about? Hannah Ferguson has just left the home of an older couple who disagree that she should run for parliament when I meet her at the Lewisham West light rail stop on the Greenway in Sydney’s inner-west. It is a perfect sunny winter afternoon and we are in the geographical centre of Grayndler, the electorate she wants to take from the prime minister , Anthony Albanese. The couple emailed Ferguson after she announced her plans to run, declaring, she says, that they liked her but didn’t agree with her tilt for parliament. She tells me she asked to sit down with them and explain herself, and believes they’ve come around to the idea of her running – and might even support her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 她写了两本书，创办了一家进步媒体公司，并计划废黜总理——这一切都是在她 30 岁之前完成的。她在做什么？汉娜·弗格森 (Hannah Ferguson) 刚刚离开一对年长夫妇的家，当我在悉尼内西区 Greenway 的 Lewisham West 轻轨车站见到她时，他们不同意她应该竞选议会议员。这是一个完美的阳光明媚的冬日下午，我们正处于格雷德尔的地理中心，她想从总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯那里夺取选民。在她宣布参选计划后，这对夫妇给弗格森发了一封电子邮件，她说，他们喜欢她，但不同意她对议会的倾斜。她告诉我，她要求与他们坐下来解释自己的情况，并相信他们已经接受了她参选的想法，甚至可能会支持她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Hannah Ferguson's drive to enter parliament and reshape public discourse embodies a commitment to justice and action. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. Ferguson's ambition, while perhaps not explicitly framed in these terms, reflects a desire to engage with the public square and pursue a vision for her community.
reflection.zh: 汉娜·弗格森（Hannah Ferguson）渴望进入议会并重塑公共话语，体现了她对正义和行动的承诺。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。弗格森的雄心壮志，即使没有明确以此为框架，也反映了她参与公共领域并追求社区愿景的愿望。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

As leaders navigate this technological expansion, the need for wise planning and resource allocation is paramount. Committing these endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His guidance in managing resources and anticipating future needs, is essential for sustainable...

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: This Australian crisis is entering a 'confronting' new phase
title.zh: 这场澳大利亚危机正进入一个“令人不安”的新阶段

summary.en: Older Australians accounted for more than half of the fatalities in a record high of drug-induced deaths, with 2,596 deaths documented in 2024, 80.5 percent of which were from unintentional overdose. Since 2008, drug-induced deaths have surpassed road fatalities.
summary.zh: 根据2024年记录的2596例药物致死事件，其中80.5%为意外过量，老年澳大利亚人占了死亡人数的一半以上，创下药物致死新高。自2008年以来，药物致死人数已超过道路交通事故死亡人数。

body.en:
This article contains references to substance abuse and suicide.

Drug-induced deaths have hit a record high, with older Australians accounting for more than half of the fatalities.

Australia's Annual Overdose Report, released by the Penington Institute, documented 2,596 drug-induced deaths in 2024, with 80.5 per cent being from unintentional overdose.

Since 2008, more Australians have died from drug-induced deaths than road fatalities — with an average of 31 years lost per death.

"The data is quite confronting," Jake Dizard, director of research at the Penington Institute, told SBS News.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The report found that the median age of people dying from drug overdose is increasing.

For the first time, those aged between 50 and 59 accounted for almost half of all unintentional overdose deaths.

Dizard said it could be attributed to "an ageing large cohort of people who started using drugs in the 1990s and early 2000s".

"As that cohort has got older, they have become more vulnerable to drug-induced death because of the length of time that they have been using drugs and the accumulating sort of comorbidities," he said.

The report also noted that of the 428 drug-induced suicides, 39 per cent were people aged 60 and over.

Australian Alcohol and Other Drugs Council CEO Melanie Walker said the report confirms that overdose is not a "young people problem".

"It affects young people. It also affects older people. Overdose can be from illicit drug use, or it can be from prescription drug use."

The report also found that men accounted for 72.7 per cent of unintentional drug-induced deaths, people living in regional and rural areas had higher rates of death than those living in capital cities, and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced higher rates of overdose.

In 2024, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experienced an overdose rate of 29.3 per 100,000 compared to 6.6 per 100,000 for non-Indigenous people.

Opioids were responsible for 42 per cent of all drug-induced deaths in 2024, with heroin-related deaths rising from 101 deaths in 2001 to 488 deaths in 2024.

Amphetamines were involved in 772 deaths, a record high for the drug, and cocaine was involved in 141 deaths. Benzodiazepines, alcohol and antidepressants also contributed to drug-induced deaths.

Dizard said that the use of prescription opioids, such as oxycodone, has declined since 2021 — a trend seen across "a number of categories of prescription drugs".

Cocaine was the only recorded drug that saw a decrease in the median age of people dying from overdose.

The sheer number of 2,596 deaths in 2024, with older Australians disproportionately affected, speaks to a deep societal pain and brokenness. In the face of such overwhelming loss, we are...
reflection.zh: 这份报告描绘了一幅令人心痛的药物致死画面，这场危机自2008年以来在澳大利亚造成的死亡人数已超过交通事故。2024年共有2596人因此丧生，其中老年澳大利亚人受影响尤为严重，这反映了深刻的社会痛苦和破碎。面对如此巨大的损失，我们被提醒雅伟靠近心碎的人，拯救灵里破碎的人，即使在最黑暗的时刻，也能带来安慰和希望。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

title.en: Exclusive: Memo reveals why NT Police were not charged over this death in custody
title.zh: 独家：备忘录揭示了为何北领地警方未因这起狱中死亡事件被起诉

summary.en: Documents obtained by SBS News offer new insight into the police response to the death in custody of Kumanjayi White, a 24-year-old Warlpiri man who died after being restrained by officers in a supermarket. His death sparked nationwide protests and calls for an independent investigation from his family.
summary.zh: SBS新闻获得的解密文件揭示了警方对库曼贾伊·怀特（Kumanjayi White）狱中死亡事件的应对措施。这位24岁的瓦尔皮里族男子在一家超市被警官制服后死亡。他的死亡事件引发了全国范围的抗议，家属呼吁进行独立调查。

body.en:
SBS News can reveal Northern Territory Police waited four months to send the NT's Director of Public Prosecutions (NTDPP) an 'opinion file' seeking advice after the death in custody of a 24-year-old Warlpiri man.

Known as Kumanjayi White for cultural reasons, the young man who also lived with disabilities died in May last year after he was restrained by two plain-clothes police officers in the confectionery aisle of an Alice Springs supermarket.

His death sparked nationwide protests over government inaction on Aboriginal deaths in custody, with protesters echoing calls by his family for an independent investigation.

White's family launched legal action against NT Police after it was announced the two officers involved would not be prosecuted in May — but discontinued the action earlier this month.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Now, an internal memo obtained by SBS News via a Freedom of Information (FOI) request offers an insight into the reasoning behind the NTDPP's decision not to prosecute.

The email obtained through FOI is dated 26 May 2026 and was sent by the then acting director of the NTDPP Patrick Williams to all NTDPP staff announcing the news that no charges would be laid over White's death.

"Shortly following your receipt of this email, it will become public knowledge that I have determined there are no reasonable prospects of securing a conviction on any charge arising out of his death on the basis of the evidence provided by police," Williams writes in the memo.

"For that reason, I have met with them on country this morning to inform them of the view that I have reached."

Williams goes on to explain the decision, noting that the department "may be the subject of some media criticism" as a result.

"That criticism may include questioning the integrity and independence of our office, noting the relationship between the NTDPP and NT Police Force," he writes.

It notes that a police opinion file was delivered in September 2025, four months after White's death.

At that time, acting NT police commissioner Martin Dole told media that investigators had "compiled a full and comprehensive brief of evidence".

But the internal memo obtained by SBS News reveals prosecutors had asked police to obtain an additional independent report into the use of force in White's arrest "within days" of receiving the opinion file in September.

It was later revealed by Dole that this 'use of force' report was conducted by Queensland Police.

The email also shows Williams sought advice from external interstate senior and junior counsel on whether the evidence provided by police was sufficient to warrant prosecution.

Following news of White's...
body.zh: SBS 新闻透露，在一名 24 岁瓦尔皮里男子在拘留期间死亡后，北领地警方等了四个月才向北领地检察长 (NTDPP) 发送一份寻求建议的“意见文件”。 由于文化原因，这名年轻人被称为库曼贾伊·怀特 (Kumanjayi White)，他也是一名残疾人，去年 5 月在爱丽丝泉超市的糖果过道里被两名便衣警察制服后死亡。 他的死亡引发了全国范围内的抗议活动，抗议政府对拘留中的原住民死亡事件不采取行动，抗议者响应他的家人要求进行独立调查的呼吁。 怀特的家人在五月宣布两名涉案警官不会被起诉后，对北领地警方发起了法律诉讼，但本月早些时候停止了这一行动。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 现在，SBS 新闻通过信息自由 (FOI) 请求获得的一份内部备忘录提供了对 NTDPP 决定不起诉背后原因的深入了解。 通过信息自由获得的电子邮件日期为 2026 年 5 月 26 日，由时任 NTDPP 代理主任帕特里克·威廉姆斯 (Patrick Williams) 发送给所有 NTDPP 工作人员，宣布不会对怀特之死提出任何指控。 威廉姆斯在备忘录中写道：“在您收到这封电子邮件后不久，公众就会知道，我已经确定，根据警方提供的证据，对因他的死亡而产生的任何指控都没有合理的定罪前景。” “出于这个原因，我今天早上在乡村会见了他们，告诉他们我所达成的观点。” 威廉姆斯接着解释了这一决定，并指出该部门因此“可能成为一些媒体批评的对象”。 他写道：“这种批评可能包括质疑我们办公室的完整性和独立性，并指出 NTDPP 和北领地警察部队之间的关系。” 它指出，警方的意见文件于 2025 年 9 月提交，即怀特去世四个月后。 当时，北领地代理警察局长马丁·多尔（Martin Dole）告诉媒体，调查人员已经“编制了一份完整且全面的证据简介”。 但 SBS​​ 新闻获得的内部备忘录显示，检察官已要求警方在 9 月份收到意见文件后“几天内”就逮捕怀特时使用武力的情况获取一份额外的独立报告。 多尔后来透露，这份“使用武力”报告是由昆士兰警方进行的。 该电子邮件还显示，威廉姆斯就警方提供的证据是否足以起诉，向外部州际高级和初级律师寻求建议。 继怀特的消息...

reflection.en: The death of Kumanjayi White and the subsequent protests underscore a deep yearning for justice and accountability. The call for an independent investigation echoes the ancient prophetic cry for justice to be a powerful, unstoppable force, like a mighty river flowing through the land. May this pursuit lead to healing and true resolution for all involved.
reflection.zh: 库曼贾伊·怀特的死亡以及随后的抗议活动，凸显了人们对公正和问责的深切渴望。要求进行独立调查的呼声，呼应了古代先知们关于公正如江河般奔腾不息的呼喊。愿这一追求能为所有相关方带来医治和真正的解决。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: A teenager's death has prompted fresh calls for relationship education
title.zh: 少女之死引发关于关系教育的新呼吁

summary.en: The death of a 16-year-old girl, found unresponsive at a Sydney home and later dying in hospital, has led to prominent calls for expanded relationship education, with reports suggesting sexual choking as a possible factor.
summary.zh: 一名16岁的少女在悉尼一处住宅被发现时没有反应，后在医院不治身亡。据报道，死因可能与性窒息有关，这一悲剧引发了公众对扩大关系教育的呼吁。

body.en:
A teenage girl's tragic death, which has been reported as being linked to sexual choking, has sparked high-profile calls for broadened relationship education.

A 16-year-old girl was found unresponsive at an Elanora Heights home, on Sydney's Northern Beaches, on Sunday.

Police declined to confirm reports detectives were investigating sexual choking as a possible factor in the death.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Independent MP Zali Steggall mentioned the reports after a National Cabinet meeting on Wednesday affirmed a commitment to ending gender-based violence.

She said agreed measures were weak and pushed for more action, including a respectful relationship education campaign.

"My call for a national education campaign has been underscored by the devastating news today of the death of a 16-year-old Northern Beaches girl," Steggall said in a statement.

"My thoughts are with her family, friends and community at this incredibly difficult time."

Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said there was no safe way to engage in choking.

"I'm sure I've said it to you in the past almost 60 per cent of young people report they've experienced choking in a recent sexual encounter," she told ABC Radio on Thursday morning.

"I can't say anything, obviously, about this tragic situation in NSW ... but in general terms, figures like that just concern me so deeply.

"There is no safe way of choking someone. Parents have to use this opportunity to talk to their young people."

A survey of 4702 Australians between 18 and 35 in 2024 found 57 per cent of respondents had been choked during sex at least once.

One-third of those respondents reported it occurring for the first time between 19 and 21.

The report's co-author noted choking in a sexual context could lead to serious brain injuries, including memory loss and issues with problem-solving.

"It doesn't matter if there are no apparent injuries, or whether the person consented," Professor Heather Douglas said at the time.

"Brain injury can also be incremental — getting a bit worse with each choking — and the person may not know they have suffered a brain injury. The effects of repeated strangling are insidious and build over time."

body.zh: 据报道，一名少女的惨死与性窒息有关，这引发了人们对扩大关系教育的高调呼吁。 周日，一名 16 岁女孩被发现在悉尼北部海滩埃拉诺拉高地 (Elanora Heights) 的一处家中失去知觉。 警方拒绝证实侦探正在调查性窒息可能是死亡原因的报道。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 独立议员扎利·斯特格尔在周三的国家内阁会议确认了结束性别暴力的承诺后提到了这些报告。 她表示商定的措施很薄弱，并敦促采取更多行动，包括开展相互尊重的关系教育活动。 斯特格尔在一份声明中说：“今天一名 16 岁北部海滩女孩死亡的毁灭性消息凸显了我对全国教育运动的呼吁。” “在这个极其困难的时刻，我的心与她的家人、朋友和社区同在。” 社会服务部长塔尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 表示，没有安全的方法可以让孩子窒息。 “我确信我过去曾对你说过，近 60% 的年轻人表示他们在最近的性接触中经历过窒息，”她周四早上告诉 ABC 电台。 “显然，对于新南威尔士州的这一悲惨局势，我无法说什么……但总的来说，这样的数字让我深感担忧。 “没有安全的方法可以让某人窒息。父母必须利用这个机会与年轻人交谈。” 2024 年对 4702 名 18 岁至 35 岁的澳大利亚人进行的一项调查发现，57% 的受访者在性行为中至少被窒息过一次。 三分之一的受访者表示第一次发生这种情况是在 19 岁至 21 岁之间。 该报告的合著者指出，在性行为中窒息可能会导致严重的脑损伤，包括记忆丧失和解决问题的问题。 希瑟·道格拉斯教授当时表示：“是否没有明显的伤害，或者当事人是否同意，这并不重要。” “脑损伤也可能是渐进的——每次窒息都会变得更严重——而且患者可能不知道自己已经遭受了脑损伤。反复勒死的影响是阴险的，并且会随着时间的推移而增强。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The tragic death of a 16-year-old girl, reportedly linked to dangerous sexual practices, underscores a profound societal failure in equipping young people with knowledge about healthy relationships and consent. This incident serves as a stark reminder of the vulnerability of youth and the critical need for comprehensive education that can prevent such...
reflection.zh: 一名16岁少女的悲惨死亡，据报道与危险的性行为有关，这凸显了社会在向年轻人传授健康关系和知情同意知识方面的严重不足。这一事件令人痛心地提醒我们年轻人的脆弱性，以及全面教育对于防止此类毁灭性后果的紧迫性，这与先知呼吁为受压迫者辩护、为弱势群体发声的精神不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Australia wants more data centres. A disagreement over power sources stands in the way
title.zh: 澳大利亚希望增加数据中心数量，但能源来源问题阻碍了发展

summary.en: Proposed legislation requiring data centre developers to supply their own renewable energy sources has met with opposition. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has indicated a more flexible approach after Queensland and the Northern Territory resisted standards for new data centre developments to use renewables instead of...
summary.zh: 要求数据中心开发商提供自有可再生能源的拟议立法遭到了反对。在昆士兰州和北领地抵制要求新建数据中心使用可再生能源而非煤炭和天然气的标准后，总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯表示将采取更灵活的做法。

body.en:
Two jurisdictions have forced the prime minister to back down on a major policy that would have required all new AI data centres to be powered by renewable energy rather than coal and gas.

Anthony Albanese left the door open at a meeting of the nation's leaders on Wednesday to a more "flexible" approach as Queensland and the Northern Territory refused to agree to standards requiring them to use renewables for new data centre developments.

He announced the agreement on the AI laws alongside domestic violence measures and firearm reforms following a meeting of National Cabinet in Sydney.

"We want to make sure that in attracting investment, we don't have eight different systems operating around the country," he said on Wednesday.

"That's why we came to a common position, which recognises that all states aren't exactly the same, and that was accommodated in the way that we normally do in a flexible way."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas said the nation's leaders agreed renewables would be the main form of energy to power future data centres in Australia.

"Acknowledging that there are different circumstances through the fact that in Queensland, for instance, they have state-owned generation," he told ABC's 7.30 on Wednesday.

"So there's no need for the federal government to use its powers that it has to override what states want."

Gregor Verbic, an energy expert at Sydney University, said the national grid was facing the imminent closure of multiple coal-fired power stations.

"(It) will leave a huge gap in the generation capacity, and we are not building new capacity fast enough," he told the Australian Associated Press news agency.

The federal government has proposed legislation to force data centre developers to provide their own renewable energy source.

Both the Queensland and NT governments provided considerable pushback, with the final national agreement failing to mention renewable energy directly.

Verbic said ensuring the energy brought online is renewable is essential to meet Australia's emissions reduction targets.

Albanese flagged draft legislation will be introduced by the end of 2026, with the aim for it to be passed in early 2027.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 两个司法管辖区迫使总理放弃一项重大政策，该政策要求所有新的人工智能数据中心均由可再生能源而不是煤炭和天然气供电。 由于昆士兰州和北领地拒绝同意要求他们使用可再生能源进行新数据中心开发的标准，安东尼·阿尔博内斯在周三的国家领导人会议上为采取更“灵活”的方法敞开了大门。 在悉尼举行的国家内阁会议后，他宣布就人工智能法以及家庭暴力措施和枪支改革达成协议。 “我们希望确保在吸引投资时，我们不会在全国各地运营八个不同的系统，”他周三表示。 “这就是为什么我们达成了共同立场，承认所有州并不完全相同，并且我们以通常灵活的方式适应了这一点。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 南澳大利亚州州长 Peter Malinauskas 表示，国家领导人同意可再生能源将成为澳大利亚未来数据中心供电的主要能源形式。 “承认存在不同的情况，例如在昆士兰州，他们有国有发电，”他周三告诉美国广播公司的 7.30。 “因此，联邦政府没有必要使用其权力来推翻各州的意愿。” 悉尼大学能源专家Gregor Verbic表示，国家电网面临着多个燃煤发电站即将关闭的问题。 他告诉澳大利亚美联社：“这将在发电能力方面留下巨大缺口，而我们建设新能力的速度不够快。” 联邦政府已提议立法，迫使数据中心开发商提供自己的可再生能源。 昆士兰州和北领地政府都提出了相当大的阻力，最终的国家协议没有直接提及可再生能源。 韦尔比克表示，确保上网能源是可再生能源对于实现澳大利亚的减排目标至关重要。 阿尔巴尼亚提出的立法草案将于 2026 年底提出，目标是在 2027 年初获得通过。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Effective governance often requires navigating complex disagreements. When leaders and jurisdictions clash over policy, as seen with Australia's proposed data center regulations, the need for wise counsel and collaborative solutions becomes paramount. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that without it, plans falter, but with many advisors, they succeed.
reflection.zh: 有效的治理常常需要处理复杂的意见分歧。当领导人和地区在政策上发生冲突时，正如澳大利亚拟议的数据中心法规所见，明智的建议和协作解决方案的需求变得至关重要。《箴言》11:14 提醒我们，没有它，计划就会失败，但有许多谋士，计划就会成功。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Albanese reveals humanitarian visa intake won't be cut, amid migration reform questions
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯透露人道主义签证配额不会削减，移民改革问题引发关注

summary.en: Labor has been signalling an upcoming shift in migration policy, as the prime minister quelled speculation on a key detail.
summary.zh: 工党一直预示着移民政策将发生转变，而总理则平息了关于一个关键细节的猜测。

body.en:
The Albanese government has denied plans to slash Australia’s humanitarian intake by a third, after reports the cut was being considered as part of a broader push to reduce net overseas migration.

On Thursday, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said in a statement the government's 20,000 humanitarian placements would "be continued in future years, consistent with Australia’s humanitarian commitments".

The statement followed reporting on Thursday morning by The Australian Financial Review newspaper that Labor appeared poised to reduce humanitarian placements from 20,000 to 13,750 at the start of the next financial year and that it had factored the decrease into migration forecasts.

A spokesman for Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told SBS News earlier on Thursday that the final decision on next year's humanitarian intake had not yet been made and linked the process to next year's budget. At the time he did not rule out cuts.

But in his statement to SBS News, Albanese said the existing figure "remains government policy".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the wake of multiple international conflicts around the world, Labor has made a series of increases to the humanitarian intake, pushing it to its current high.

The confusion comes as the government is anticipated to announce an overhaul of its migration policy.

Labor had been expected to reveal details in a National Press Club address by Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke earlier this month, but the speech was cancelled after Burke failed to secure cabinet agreement on the best approach.

Since then, Albanese has refused to give further updates, telling ABC radio on Tuesday that there are a "series of plans in place" but there is still "more work to do" to finalise them. He declined to set a timeframe for immigration announcements, saying only that they would come at "appropriate times".

Migration targets have been the source of recent public debate, with One Nation pushing a tough anti-migration stance and gaining in the polls.

Both major parties have sought to restrict their own immigration policies while denying that this is in response to the minor party's growing popularity.

Opposition leader Angus Taylor has said the Coalition will cap net overseaos migration (NOM) at or below the number of homes built in Australia the previous year. Current building rates suggest their figure would be under 180,000; however, the Coalition is yet to announce where they would restrict immigration to reach that figure.

In 2024-2025, NOM was 306,000. Labor's budgetary forecasts suggest it will decline to 225,000 by 2027-2028, after the party has made concerted efforts to bring it down from a...
body.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚政府否认了将澳大利亚的人道主义接收人数削减三分之一的计划，此前有报道称，这一削减被视为更广泛推动减少净海外移民的一部分。 周四，总理安东尼·艾博内塞在一份声明中表示，政府将“在未来几年继续提供 20,000 名人道主义安置，这符合澳大利亚的人道主义承诺”。 周四上午，《澳大利亚金融评论报》报道称，工党似乎准备在下个财政年度开始时将人道主义安置人数从 20,000 人减少到 13,750 人，并且已将这一减少纳入移民预测。 内政部长托尼·伯克(Tony Burke)发言人周四早些时候告诉SBS新闻，尚未就明年的人道主义援助接收做出最终决定，并将这一过程与明年的预算联系起来。当时他并不排除裁员的可能性。 但阿尔巴尼斯在向 SBS 新闻发表的声明中表示，现有数字“仍然是政府政策”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 在世界各地发生多起国际冲突后，工党对人道主义援助接收量进行了一系列增加，使其达到目前的最高水平。 混乱出现之际，预计政府将宣布对其移民政策进行彻底改革。 工党原本预计将在本月早些时候内政部长托尼·伯克（Tony Burke）在全国新闻俱乐部发表的讲话中透露细节，但由于伯克未能就最佳方法与内阁达成一致，该讲话被取消。 此后，阿尔巴内斯拒绝提供进一步的更新，他周二告诉美国广播公司广播电台，已经制定了“一系列计划”，但仍有“更多工作要做”才能最终确定。他拒绝设定移民公告的时间表，只表示它们会在“适当的时间”发布。 移民目标一直是最近公众辩论的焦点，一国党推行强硬的反移民立场并在民意调查中获胜。 两个主要政党都试图限制自己的移民政策，同时否认这是为了应对小党日益受欢迎的情况。 反对党领袖安格斯·泰勒表示，联盟党将把净海外移民（NOM）限制在或低于去年澳大利亚建造的房屋数量。目前的建筑率表明他们的数字将低于 180,000；然而，联盟党尚未宣布将在哪些方面限制移民达到这一数字。 2024-2025 年，NOM 为 306,000。工党的预算预测表明，在该党齐心协力将其从2027年至2028年期间降至225,000人之后

reflection.en: Prime Minister Albanese's assurance that Australia's humanitarian visa intake will not be cut offers a measure of stability for vulnerable individuals seeking refuge. This decision reflects a commitment to upholding humanitarian principles, even amidst broader migration policy discussions. It echoes the call to "speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯总理保证澳大利亚的人道主义签证配额不会被削减，这为寻求庇护的弱势群体带来了一定的稳定。这一决定反映了在更广泛的移民政策讨论中，仍致力于维护人道主义原则。这呼应了“为不能说话者说话”（箴言 31:8）的呼吁，确保最弱势群体在政策变动中不会被忽视。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: FS stresses Hong Kong-Singapore cooperation
title.zh: 财政司强调香港新加坡合作

summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan acknowledged the longstanding rivalry between Hong Kong and Singapore but emphasized that their shared future depends on increased collaboration. He spoke at the Singapore National Day Dinner, highlighting the cities' common traits of resilience and adaptability, and proposed a spirit of...
summary.zh: 财政司陈茂波承认香港和新加坡之间长期存在竞争，但强调他们共同的未来取决于更深入的合作。他在新加坡国庆晚宴上发表讲话，强调了这两个城市长期以来共同的特质：韧性、敏捷性和快速适应能力。他提议，双方应“在必要时竞争，在最重要的地方合作”，并以这种“合作竞争”的精神，各自发挥最大潜力，为区域做出贡献。

body.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan acknowledged the longstanding rivalry between Hong Kong and Singapore, but insisted their shared future hinges on deeper collaboration. Speaking at the Singapore National Day Dinner on Friday, Chan highlighted the common traits that have long defined both cities: resilience, agility, and an uncanny ability to adapt at speed. "We should compete where we must, and co-operate where it matters most. Some describe this as 'co-opetition'. Whatever the term, it is in this spirit that our two cities will each realise our full potential, and that our partnership will contribute most to the region," he said. To underscore the depth of their economic ties, Chan pointed to substantial cross-investments with Singapore’s holdings in Hong Kong standing at HK$310 billion, while the SAR’s stake in the Lion City is at around HK$340 billion. These figures, he said, are proof of a relationship built on solid ground. Looking ahead, he proposed that the two financial hubs pool their strengths to amplify the region’s global clout – particularly in shaping standards for emerging sectors like green finance and artificial intelligence governance. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 财政司司长陈茂波承认香港和新加坡之间长期存在竞争，但坚称它们的共同未来取决于更深层次的合作。周五在新加坡国庆晚宴上发表讲话时，陈强调了长期以来定义这两个城市的共同特征：韧性、敏捷性和不可思议的快速适应能力。他说：“我们应该在必要的地方竞争，在最重要的地方合作。有些人将其描述为‘合作竞争’。无论用什么术语，正是本着这种精神，我们两个城市将充分发挥我们的潜力，我们的伙伴关系将为该地区做出最大贡献。”为了强调两国经济联系的深度，陈指出，新加坡在香港的持股金额高达 3,100 亿港元，而香港特区在狮城的持股金额约为 3,400 亿港元。他说，这些数字证明了两国关系建立在坚实的基础上。展望未来，他建议这两个金融中心汇集优势，扩大该地区的全球影响力，特别是在制定绿色金融和人工智能治理等新兴行业的标准方面。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: In the complex dance between competition and cooperation, leaders often seek a path that maximizes mutual benefit. Financial Secretary Paul Chan's vision for Hong Kong and Singapore to embrace 'co-opetition' suggests a pragmatic approach to shared challenges and opportunities. This echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors to divine guidance, trusting...
reflection.zh: 在竞争与合作的复杂博弈中，领导者常常寻求最大化互惠互利的途径。财政司陈茂波提出的香港与新加坡拥抱“合作竞争”的愿景，为共同的挑战和机遇提供了一种务实的策略。这与凡事交托雅伟，信靠祂的指引必得成功的智慧相呼应。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

Micah 6:8 reminds us that Yahweh requires us to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with Him. This involves taking responsibility for our actions and ensuring the safety and well-being of our...

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

The flight marked a collaboration between mainland Chinese autonomous aerial vehicle firm EHang, local transport operator Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings and the city’s technology hub, Cyberport. The flight took place at Cyberport in Pok Fu...

It is a testament to human ingenuity and collaborative effort. As this new venture takes flight, may its creators and operators commit their work to Yahweh, seeking His wisdom and guidance for...

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

title.en: Uber, Didi say preparing to apply for ride-hailing service licence as gov’t invites submissions
title.zh: 优步、滴滴表示正准备申请网约车服务牌照，政府已开放申请

summary.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry.
summary.zh: 网约车服务公司优步（Uber）和滴滴出行（Didi）表示，它们正准备根据政府周五启动的新计划申请牌照，该计划旨在规范快速发展的行业。

body.en: Ride-hailing services Uber and Didi have said they are preparing to apply for licences under a new scheme opened by the government on Friday, an effort to regulate the fast-growing industry. The Uber app. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In response to HKPF, Uber said on Friday: “We are preparing our application for a ride-hailing platform license with a firm commitment to delivering a safe, high-quality experience for passengers and strong support for driver-partners and the Hong Kong Government.” Uber’s reply came as the government opened applications for ride-hailing licences on Friday morning. This follows the passage of a bill last October that introduced laws intended to regulate the sector under a licencing regime. Under the new regime, all ride-hailing platforms must hold a licence to operate in Hong Kong. Ride-hailing drivers must must also hold a specific licence, which is due to be issued from November. Applications to sit the written test for this licence opened earlier this month . Operators applying for a platform licence must have a permanent office in Hong Kong and experience offering services in a city with a comparably large population, and must also provide evidence the company’s financial capacity. Ride-hailing app Didi. Photo: Rhoda Kwan/HKFP. In addition to US-based Uber, mainland China’s Didi has also indicated it will apply. Didi told local media that it welcomed the authorities’ announcement of the application details, and added that the clear criteria introduced by the government is imperative for the regulatory framework’s success. The company said it would submit its application “as soon as possible.” HKFP has reached out to Didi for comment. New legislation Ride-hailing platforms have grown rapidly in recent years by offering convenient services amid mounting public frustration directed at Hong Kong’s conventional taxi fleet. Uber first entered the local market in 2014, followed by Didi in 2018. But ride-hailing vehicles have since operated in a legal grey area with no dedicated legislation. The city’s taxi industry has long accused ride-hailing platforms of impacting cab drivers’ livelihoods . For years, they have pushed the government to introduce a mechanism regulating ride-hailing operators. Vehicles in Hong Kong. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The ride-hailing licence applications opened on Friday are a core part of the government’s long-awaited regulatory efforts. From next August, when the regulatory regime comes into full force, operators of ride-hailing platforms that do not have a licence will face a maximum fine of HK$1 million and up to a year in prison. Drivers convicted of carrying passengers for hire or reward without a permit will be disqualified from...
body.zh: 叫车服务优步和滴滴表示，他们正准备根据政府周五启动的一项新计划申请牌照，以规范这个快速增长的行业。优步应用程序。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。优步周五在回应香港警务处时表示：“我们正在准备申请网约车平台牌照，坚定承诺为乘客提供安全、优质的体验，并为司机合作伙伴和香港政府提供大力支持。”周五上午，政府开放打车牌照申请后，优步做出了回应。此前，去年 10 月通过了一项法案，该法案引入了旨在根据许可制度监管该行业的法律。根据新制度，所有网约车平台必须持有香港运营牌照。网约车司机还必须持有特定许可证，该许可证将于 11 月起颁发。参加该许可证笔试的申请已于本月初开放。申请平台牌照的运营商必须在香港拥有常设办事处，并具有在人口较多的城市提供服务的经验，还必须提供公司的财务能力证明。打车应用滴滴。照片：Rhoda Kwan/HKFP。除了美国的Uber外，中国大陆的滴滴出行也表示将申请。滴滴向当地媒体表示，欢迎当局公布申请细节，并补充说，政府出台的明确标准对于监管框架的成功至关重要。该公司表示将“尽快”提交申请。 HKFP 已联系滴滴征求意见。新立法近年来，随着公众对香港传统出租车队的不满情绪日益浓厚，网约车平台通过提供便捷的服务而迅速发展。优步于 2014 年首次进入当地市场，滴滴也于 2018 年进入。但此后，网约车一直处于法律灰色地带，没有专门的立法。该市的出租车行业长期以来一直指责叫车平台影响出租车司机的生计。多年来，他们一直推动政府引入监管网约车运营商的机制。香港的车辆。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。周五开放的网约车牌照申请是政府期待已久的监管工作的核心部分。从明年8月起，监管制度全面生效，无牌照的网约车平台运营商将面临最高100万港元的罚款和最高一年的监禁。未经许可载客或取酬而被定罪的司机将被取消资格...

reflection.en: As ride-hailing giants Uber and Didi prepare to apply for licenses under Hong Kong's new regulatory scheme, their actions reflect a commitment to operating within established civic structures. This willingness to submit to governing authorities, as outlined in Romans 13:1, is vital for a stable society and for businesses to contribute to the common good. It...
reflection.zh: 随着网约车巨头优步和滴滴准备根据香港新的监管计划申请牌照，它们的行动体现了在既定公民框架内运营的承诺。这种顺服执政掌权者的意愿，正如《罗马书》13:1所阐明的，对于社会稳定和企业为共同利益做出贡献至关重要。它提醒我们，即使在一个快速发展的行业中，与政府负责任的互动也能确保所有公民的安全和优质服务。

verse.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established.
verse.textZh: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。

title.en: MTR Corp to deploy a world-first use of skidding method for Hung Shui Kiu station
title.zh: 港铁洪水桥站将采用全球首创“横移施工法”

summary.en: MTR Corporation will implement a world-first skidding method for a heavy-rail project to construct the Hung Shui Kiu station. This innovative approach involves prefabricating 10,000-tonne structures and sliding them into place next to the operational Tuen Ma Line, aiming for completion by 2030 while minimizing service...
summary.zh: 港铁公司将在洪水桥站建设中采用全球首创的重铁“横移施工法”。这项创新技术涉及预制每座重约1万公吨的车站结构，并将其横移至运行中的屯马线旁。此举旨在克服时间限制，确保工程于2030年完工，同时减少对现有铁路服务的影响。

body.en: Hong Kong’s rail operator will use a skidding method – the first worldwide for a heavy-rail project – to build Hung Shui Kiu station, helping to overcome time constraints and ensure completion by 2030. The MTR Corporation said on Friday that the station structures, each weighing about 10,000 tonnes, would be assembled from prefabricated components at worksites on either side of an operational viaduct. They would then be skidded into their designated positions alongside the operating Tuen Ma...
body.zh: 香港铁路运营商将采用滑移方法（全球首个重轨项目）建造洪水桥车站，帮助克服时间限制并确保在 2030 年完工。港铁公司周五表示，车站结构每个重约 10,000 吨，将在运营中的高架桥两侧的工地上用预制构件组装而成。然后，他们将被滑行到正在运行的屯马旁边的指定位置......

reflection.en: The challenge of building the Hung Shui Kiu station over an active railway requires more than just raw power; it demands the glory of creative problem-solving. By using this world-first skidding method for 10,000-tonne components, engineers demonstrate the God-given human capacity to search out wisdom and master complex physical environments. As we look...
reflection.zh: 在运行中的屯马线旁建造洪水桥站，不仅需要强大的动力，更需要发挥创意解决问题的“荣耀”。工程师们针对1万公吨的结构件采用全球首创的“横移施工法”，展示了雅伟赋予人类探求智慧、克服复杂物理环境的能力。当我们展望2030年工程完工时，我们可以感悟到，正是雅伟赐予人类的聪明才智，让我们能够以创新的方式建设安全、高效连接社区的道路。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Tai Po fire: 96.5% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners agree to gov’t buyback scheme as 70 remain undecided
title.zh: 大埔火灾：王福庭业主96.5%同意政府回购计划，仍有70人未决定

summary.en: Over 96% of homeowners at the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court have accepted the government's buyback offer for their flats, with the scheme deadline approaching. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho reported that 1,914 out of 1,984 owners had agreed, leaving 70 undecided just days before the offer expires.
summary.zh: 在火灾后的王福庭，超过96%的业主已接受政府的回购提议，而该计划的截止日期临近。房屋局局长何永贤报告称，在1984名业主中已有1914人同意，仅剩70人在最后期限前仍未做出决定。

body.en: More than 96 per cent of homeowners at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have agreed to sell their flats to the government under an official buyback scheme that is due to expire next Monday, a senior official has said. Wang Fuk Court on May 4, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said on Friday that, as of Thursday, 1,914 of the estate’s 1,984 owners – or 96.5 per cent – had signed and returned a letter of acceptance regarding the government’s buyback offer. That means 70 owners remained undecided, with only a few days remaining before the deadline on Monday at 5pm. “There are a little over three days left from today, and we encourage these owners to seize the opportunity to sign and return the letter of acceptance before 5pm Monday,” Ho wrote in a Chinese-language Facebook post. In an emailed reply to HKFP on Friday, the government said 1,526 homeowners – 76.9 per cent of the total – have also taken the next step in the process, signing a formal sale and purchase agreement. The government announced the buyback scheme in February, after a blaze tore through seven residential towers at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on November 26 last year, killing 168 people and displacing thousands at the government-subsidised estate. Prices have been set at HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot, depending on whether the homeowner has paid land premiums. Owners can choose to receive cash or swap their flat for a new government-subsidised unit under a special sales scheme. Around 4,400 government-subsidised flats have been reserved for those who opt in for the scheme. Flat selection to begin Sept Ho said on Friday that the government would use a computerised lottery to determine when homeowners who opt in to the flat swap can select their new units, with priority given to owners who returned their acceptance letters before June 30. Hong Kong Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho addresses the Legislative Council on January 14, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Starting from the end of September, arrangements will be made for between 50 and 80 households daily to select a new flat, Ho added. She also said that the 10 estates included in the scheme are spread across the city, and include about 2,800 units with a saleable area exceeding 400 square feet. Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong has said that authorities may acquire unsold property titles through “legislative means.” Some Wang Fuk Court residents have said they felt they had no choice but to accept the government’s buyback offer after authorities said they would not rebuild the fire-hit estate on its original site.
body.zh: 一名高级官员表示，受火灾影响的宏福苑超过 96% 的房主已同意根据一项将于下周一到期的官方回购计划将其公寓出售给政府。宏福苑，2026 年 5 月 4 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。房屋局局长何温妮周五表示，截至周四，该庄园 1,984 名业主中的 1,914 名业主（即 96.5%）已签署并返回有关政府回购提议的接受书。这意味着 70 名业主尚未做出决定，距离周一下午 5 点的截止日期仅剩几天时间。何先生在脸书中文版帖子中写道：“距离今天还有三天多一点的时间，我们鼓励这些业主抓住机会，在周一下午 5 点之前签署并返回接受函。”在周五给 HKFP 的电子邮件回复中，政府表示，1,526 名房主（占总数的 76.9%）也已采取下一步行动，签署了正式的买卖协议。去年11月26日，大埔宏福苑发生大火，烧毁了七栋住宅楼，造成168人死亡，并导致该政府资助庄园内的数千人流离失所，之后，政府于2月宣布了回购计划。价格定为每平方尺8,000港元或10,500港元，视乎业主是否缴付地价而定。业主可以选择获得现金或根据特别销售计划将其单位换成政府补贴的新单位。约4,400个政府资助单位已预留给选择参与该计划的人士。开始选楼 何九周五表示，政府将使用电脑抽签来决定选择换屋的业主何时可以挑选新单位，并优先考虑在 6 月 30 日之前寄回录取通知书的业主。香港房屋局局长何温妮于 2026 年 1 月 14 日在立法会发表讲话。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 Ho补充说，从9月底开始，每天将安排50至80户家庭选择新单位。她又表示，计划涵盖的10个屋村遍布全港，包括约2,800个单位，实用面积超过400平方尺。财政副司长黄伟纶表示，当局可能会通过“立法手段”收购未售出的房产。宏福苑的一些居民表示，在当局表示不会在原址重建遭受火灾的屋苑后，他们别无选择，只能接受政府的回购提议。

reflection.en: The government's buyback scheme for the fire-affected Wang Fuk Court homeowners demonstrates a commitment to alleviating hardship. Jeremiah 22:3 calls leaders to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This initiative, while not strictly about oppression, reflects a governmental...
reflection.zh: 政府为受火灾影响的王福庭业主提供的回购计划，体现了缓解困境的承诺。耶利米书22:3呼吁领导者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”这项举措虽然不直接涉及压迫，但反映了政府在危机时刻照顾其人民的责任。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Man nabbed after over 4k litres of illicit fuel seized
title.zh: 香港仔检获逾四千公升私油，一名男子被捕

summary.en: Authorities in Aberdeen arrested a driver and seized approximately 4,150 litres of suspected illicit fuel worth HK$136,000. The operation, involving police and customs, uncovered a syndicate using sampans and rafts to store the untaxed fuel.
summary.zh: 当局在香港仔逮捕了一名司机，并检获约4,150公升疑似私油，市值约13.6万港元。警方、海关及消防处联合行动，揭发一个有黑社会背景的集团利用舢舨和浮排储存这些未完税燃料。

body.en: A light goods vehicle driver has been arrested after authorities seized about 4,150 litres of suspected illicit fuel in Aberdeen. Authorities also seized the vehicle and a sampan in a cross-departmental operation held by police, customs, and the Fire Services Department that took place on Thursday. The suspected illicit fuel that was untaxed had an estimated market value of HK$136,000. Police senior inspector Kwan Ka-ki said a syndicate with triad background had allegedly used sampans and rafts to store suspected illicit fuel at the Aberdeen Typhoon Shelter. Officers found about 1,800 litres of suspected illicit fuel on the vehicle parked nearby and 84 barrels of suspected illicit fuel in the sampan. “Following in-depth investigation and intelligence analysis, police found that the syndicate made use of vehicles to transport illicit fuel from other places to the Aberdeen Wholesale Fish Market area, then used speedboats to transport them to the typhoon shelter,” she said. “They then used specific vessels parked at the shelter as mobile fuel storage to illegally store a large amount of illicit fuel.” The probe also showed that the illicit fuel was used to supply vessels involved in smuggling activities, Kwan said. Senior station officer Yeung Chun-wa from the Fire Services Department said the 34-year-old arrestee will be prosecuted for allegedly violating the Dangerous Goods Ordinance and Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulation. “There are residential estates near the site. In case of fire or explosion, it could lead to massive injuries and casualties, and significant financial losses,” he said. Authorities did not rule out further arrests. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 当局在阿伯丁查获约 4,150 升可疑非法燃油后，逮捕了一名轻型货车司机。周四，警方、海关和消防处进行了跨部门行动，当局还扣押了这辆车和一艘舢舨。未征税的怀疑非法燃油估计市值为港币136,000元。警方高级督察关嘉基表示，一个具有三合会背景的犯罪团伙涉嫌利用舢舨和木筏在香港仔避风塘储存可疑非法燃料。警方在附近停放的车辆上发现约1,800公升疑似非法燃油，并在舢舨内发现84桶疑似非法燃油。她说：“警方经过深入调查和情报分析，发现该集团利用车辆从外地运送非法燃油至香港仔鱼品批发市场一带，再利用快艇运送至避风塘。” “然后他们利用停泊在避难所的特定船只作为移动燃料储存库，非法储存大量非法燃料。”关说，调查还显示非法燃料被用来向参与走私活动的船只供应。消防处高级警署人员杨俊华表示，34岁被捕者将因涉嫌违反《危险品条例》及《危险品（管制）规例》而被检控。 “现场附近有住宅小区，一旦发生火灾或爆炸，可能会造成重大人员伤亡和重大经济损失。”他说。当局不排除进一步逮捕的可能性。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The discovery of thousands of litres of illicit fuel in Aberdeen reminds us that hidden shortcuts often lead to a dead end. While the pursuit of profit can tempt people toward deception, true prosperity is built on the foundation of honesty and shared responsibility. Integrity in our dealings, even in the 'unseen' parts of the economy, reflects a heart that...
reflection.zh: 在香港仔发现数千公升私油提醒我们，隐藏的捷径往往通向死胡同。虽然对利润的追求可能诱使人们走向欺骗，但真正的繁荣是建立在诚实和共同责任的基础之上的。我们在交易中的正直，即使是在经济中“看不见”的部分，也反映了一颗尊重雅伟公义标准的心。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Once a legend, humpback whales make a comeback in Brazil
title.zh: 曾是传奇：座头鲸在巴西海岸重现生机

summary.en: Female humpback whales off the coast of Brazil now have their pick of mates, who slap the water with their tails and jostle for attention—a scene that would have been unthinkable a few decades ago. Driven to near extinction in the 1980s, there are now about 35,000 humpback whales in the South Atlantic, almost half of...
summary.zh: 巴西海岸的雌性座头鲸现在可以挑选配偶，雄鲸们拍打水面、争夺关注——这在几十年前是不可想象的景象。自20世纪80年代濒临灭绝以来，南大西洋的座头鲸数量现已达到约3.5万头，几乎占全球总数的一半。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Female humpback whales off the coast of Brazil now have their pick of mates, who slap the water with their tails and jostle for attention—a scene that would have been unthinkable a few decades ago.

Driven to near extinction in the 1980s, there are now about 35,000 humpback whales in the South Atlantic, almost half of the world's total.

The warm waters off the coast of Brazil are the largest breeding ground for South Atlantic humpbacks. Males compete for the chance to mate, and females give birth and nurse their calves.

They also offer a bonanza to scientists who come each year to the Abrolhos archipelago off the coast of the state of Bahia to record and study hundreds of the cetaceans.

Four decades ago, no one even knew there were whales in Brazil, said Enrico Marcovaldi, founder of the Humpback Whale Institute (IBJ)—one of Brazil's leading organizations researching and protecting the species.

Humpback populations have thrived since a worldwide moratorium on commercial whaling in 1986.

The following year, Brazil banned the practice by law and later declared the Abrolhos breeding grounds a protected area.

In 2014, the humpback whale was removed from Brazil's list of threatened species, and its population has continued to thrive ever since.

Wearing a life jacket and helmet and armed with a crossbow, biologist Fabio Fontes pursues a group of males competing to mate with a female.

From his small boat, he fires an arrow that pierces the back of one whale before dropping into the water. He retrieves it with a sample of skin and blubber attached.

A team of scientists and journalists, including AFP, follows Fontes' moves from a catamaran.

Milton Marcondes, the IBJ's research coordinator, explained that the samples can be used to establish family ties between the whales, known for one of the longest migrations of any mammal on the planet.

Years ago, the researchers discovered that a humpback born in Abrolhos was related to another spotted off South Georgia, a remote island some 4,000 kilometers (2,500 miles) to the south.

The finding helped establish the migration route of the animals, which can reach up to 16 meters (roughly 50 feet) long as adults and weigh as much as six elephants.

A pattern of white markings against the black of a humpback's tail is its fingerprint—a unique pattern that allows researchers to identify individual whales from photographs.

The comparison, which once required many pairs of eyes and hours of work, can now be done in seconds by Happy Whale, an artificial intelligence platform that has already identified 8,300 Brazilian humpbacks.

title.en: Tracks and tooth marks reveal bone-crushing dogs at Nebraska supervolcano ashfall site
title.zh: 内布拉斯加超级火山灰遗址发现“碎骨犬”足迹与齿痕

summary.en: Researchers at Ashfall Fossil Beds State Historical Park in Nebraska have identified footprints and tooth marks from prehistoric 'bone-crushing dogs' (Borophaginae) dating back 12 million years. These findings, preserved in volcanic ash, provide new insights into the interactions between ancient carnivores and their...
summary.zh: 内布拉斯加州灰落化石床国家历史公园的研究人员发现了1200万年前史前“碎骨犬”（Borophaginae）的足迹和齿痕。这些保存在火山灰中的发现为古代食肉动物与其猎物（包括犀牛和马）之间的互动提供了新的见解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Thirty-five years on—well, 12 million, technically—Ashfall Fossil Beds State Historical Park continues to offer important glimpses of prehistoric life in Nebraska.

Consider, for example, Borophaginae, known commonly as bone-crushing dogs. In recent years, researchers have found footprints believed to be from these carnivores amid the ash at the site. They also have found tooth marks that seem to match those of the dogs in the bones of rhinos, horses and camels that died in the ash, said Sam Matson, the park's superintendent.

However, university scientists have yet to find skeletal remains, suggesting the animals—not actual dogs but an evolutionary offshoot about the size of wolves—may have survived the ash that trapped their prey at a watering hole long enough to enjoy some meals but left the scene before they died there with their dinner.

"We even find coprolites—fossil poop—that have chips of bone in them," Matson said. "So, we know those are coming from a dog. But so far, no skeletons of the scavengers, so we don't know if they survived the event."

It is possible that researchers will yet find skeletal remains of the animals, perhaps in fossil dens.

Ashfall Fossil Beds, part of the University of Nebraska State Museum, is celebrating its 35th year in 2026. Recent years' findings about the bone-crushing dogs exemplify how research at the site, housed within 360 acres (0.6 square mile) of Nebraska prairie near Royal, Nebraska, continues to yield knowledge.

Geologists believe that this mass graveyard is the result of an enormous volcanic eruption—1,000 times larger than the 1980 Mount St. Helens blast—that occurred 12 million years ago in what is now southwest Idaho, nearly 900 miles (1,450 kilometers) due west of the Ashfall Fossil Beds.

The fine volcanic ash was deposited thousands of miles from the volcano, including across a huge area of the Great Plains. The ash from this supervolcano eruption is still intact across much of northern Nebraska, about a foot thick (30 centimeters) in most places—but 8 to 10 feet thick (2.4 to 3 meters) at the Ashfall site.

Research has determined that the site was the location of a watering hole, basically a large depression on the landscape that would retain water during the wet season and dry out during arid spells, much like waterholes dotted across the savannas of Africa today.

Fossils of pond turtles, remains of reed-like plant stems and diatoms within the ash are evidence of water, but the lack of fish fossils and the absence of channeling in the strata indicate something less permanent than a lake or stream-fed pond....
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 三十五年过去了——严格来说，是一千二百万年——火山灰化石床州立历史公园继续为人们提供内布拉斯加州史前生活的重要一瞥。 例如，Borophaginae，通常被称为碎骨狗。近年来，研究人员在现场的火山灰中发现了据信是这些食肉动物的脚印。公园负责人萨姆·马特森 (Sam Matson) 表示，他们还在死在火山灰中的犀牛、马和骆驼的骨头中发现了与狗的牙痕相似的牙痕。 然而，大学科学家尚未找到骨骼遗骸，这表明这些动物——不是真正的狗，而是狼大小的进化分支——可能在火山灰中幸存下来，火山灰将它们的猎物困在水坑里足够长的时间来享用食物，但在它们带着晚餐死去之前就离开了现场。 “我们甚至发现了粪化石——粪便化石——里面有骨头碎片，”马特森说。 “所以，我们知道那些来自狗。但到目前为止，还没有食腐动物的骨骼，所以我们不知道它们是否在事件中幸存下来。” 研究人员有可能在化石巢穴中发现这些动物的骨骼遗骸。 灰烬化石床是内布拉斯加州大学州立博物馆的一部分，将于 2026 年庆祝其成立 35 周年。近年来，有关碎骨狗的发现证明了在内布拉斯加州罗亚尔附近占地 360 英亩（0.6 平方英里）的内布拉斯加州大草原内的研究地点如何继续产出知识。 地质学家认为，这个大规模墓地是一场巨大火山喷发的结果——比 1980 年圣海伦斯火山喷发的规模大 1,000 倍——发生在 1200 万年前，位于现在的爱达荷州西南部，距离火山灰化石床正西近 900 英里（1,450 公里）。 细小的火山灰沉积在距离火山数千英里的地方，包括大平原的大片地区。在内布拉斯加州北部的大部分地区，这场超级火山喷发产生的火山灰仍然完好无损，大部分地方厚约一英尺（30 厘米），但火山灰坠落地点的火山灰厚达 8 至 10 英尺（2.4 至 3 米）。 研究确定，该地点是一个水坑的位置，基本上是景观上的一个大洼地，在雨季保留水分，在干旱时期干燥，就像今天非洲稀树草原上点缀的水坑一样。 池塘龟的化石、芦苇状植物茎的遗骸和灰烬中的硅藻都是水的证据，但缺乏鱼化石和地层中没有通道表明存在着比湖泊或溪流喂养的池塘更不永久的东西……

reflection.en: The discovery of a single tooth mark on a prehistoric rhino bone reminds us that even the smallest details of life are never truly lost to history. There is a profound dignity in the work of scientists who patiently sift through the ash of 12 million years to reconstruct the stories of creatures long gone. As we uncover these hidden tracks, we are invited...
reflection.zh: 在史前犀牛骨头上发现的一个齿痕提醒我们，生命中哪怕最微小的细节也不会在历史中真正湮灭。科学家们耐心地筛查1200万年前的火山灰，重构早已逝去的生物故事，这项工作具有深远的尊严。当我们揭开这些隐藏的足迹时，我们受邀去惊叹这个世界的复杂性——早在人类亲眼见证之前，雅伟就已经在漫长的岁月中维系着这一切。

title.en: How methylation sets a parasite in motion to invade host cells
title.zh: 甲基化如何驱动寄生虫入侵宿主细胞

summary.en: Researchers have identified how the parasite Toxoplasma gondii uses specific enzymes to trigger its movement. By activating two lysine methyltransferases in sequence, the parasite assembles the molecular machinery needed to invade host cells.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现了弓形虫（Toxoplasma gondii）如何利用特定酶来触发其运动。通过依次激活两种赖氨酸甲基转移酶，该寄生虫能够组装入侵宿主细胞所需的分子机制。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Parasites such as Toxoplasma gondii and the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum depend on rapid, precisely controlled movement to complete their life cycles. To start moving, they must assemble actin filaments at their front end and connect them to the molecular machinery that generates force. How these events are coordinated has remained unclear.

A team led by Dr. Elena Jimenez-Ruiz at LMU's Faculty of Veterinary Medicine has now shown that in T. gondii, two lysine methyltransferases become active sequentially at the pointed end of the parasite. The paper is published in the journal Nature Communications .

The newly characterized enzyme PCKMT positions the actin nucleator Formin-1 at the parasite tip, allowing local actin assembly and protrusion of the conoid, a specialized structure involved in invasion. A second methyltransferase, AKMT, then participates in the downstream reorganization that couples the actin network to force transmission.

"What surprised us is that methylation is not acting here in the nucleus, where it is best known, but directly at the parasite's motility machinery," says Jimenez-Ruiz. "These two enzymes appear to organize the transition from a parasite that is prepared to move to one that can actually generate force."

After the scientists removed PCKMT, Formin-1 failed to localize correctly, actin assembly did not initiate, and the parasites could no longer efficiently move, exit host cells or invade new ones.

The researchers also found that the related enzyme PfSET9 localizes to the apical end of P. falciparum and that its depletion strongly impairs invasion of red blood cells, suggesting that this regulatory principle may extend across so-called apicomplexan parasites.

The findings reveal lysine methylation as an unexpected regulatory layer connecting signaling, cytoskeletal activation and mechanical force. Because these methyltransferases are specific to apicomplexan parasites, they could provide promising starting points for drug development: Compounds that block their activity might disrupt parasite movement and invasion without targeting equivalent enzymes in human cells.

Peipei Qin et al, Dual apical methyltransferases orchestrate motility initiation in apicomplexan parasites, Nature Communications (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-77078-y

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 弓形虫和疟原虫等寄生虫依靠快速、精确控制的运动来完成其生命周期。为了开始移动，它们必须在前端组装肌动蛋白丝，并将它们连接到产生力的分子机器上。这些事件如何协调仍不清楚。 由慕尼黑大学兽医学院 Elena Jimenez-Ruiz 博士领导的研究小组现已证明，在弓形虫中，两种赖氨酸甲基转移酶在寄生虫的尖端依次变得活跃。该论文发表在《自然通讯》杂志上。 新鉴定的酶 PCKMT 将肌动蛋白成核剂 Formin-1 定位在寄生虫尖端，从而允许局部肌动蛋白组装和圆锥体突出，圆锥体是一种参与入侵的特殊结构。然后，第二种甲基转移酶 AKMT 参与下游重组，耦合肌动蛋白网络以强制传输。 Jimenez-Ruiz 说：“令我们惊讶的是，甲基化并不是在众所周知的细胞核中发挥作用，而是直接作用于寄生虫的运动机制。” “这两种酶似乎组织了从准备移动的寄生虫到真正能够产生力量的寄生虫的转变。” 科学家去除 PCKMT 后，Formin-1 无法正确定位，肌动蛋白组装无法启动，寄生虫无法再有效地移动、退出宿主细胞或侵入新细胞。 研究人员还发现，相关酶 PfSET9 定位于恶性疟原虫的顶端，其耗尽会严重损害红细胞的侵袭，这表明这种调节原理可能适用于所谓的顶端复门寄生虫。 研究结果表明，赖氨酸甲基化是一个意想不到的调节层，连接信号传导、细胞骨架激活和机械力。由于这些甲基转移酶是顶复门寄生虫所特有的，因此它们可以为药物开发提供有希望的起点：阻断其活性的化合物可能会破坏寄生虫的运动和入侵，而不靶向人类细胞中的等效酶。 Peipeiqin 等人，双顶端甲基转移酶协调顶端复门寄生虫的运动启动，自然通讯（2026）。 DOI：10.1038/s41467-026-77078-y 生命科学与生态学理学士。微生物学实验室背景，具有石油、天然气和可再生行业的制药新闻经验。完整档案 → 数学生物学学士学位，创意写作硕士学位。游历广泛，对科学和语言有独特的观点。完整档案...

As scientists uncover the invisible mechanics of methylation in organisms like Toxoplasma gondii, we are reminded that no part of life is accidental. These findings invite us to marvel at the deep intelligence Yahweh has...
reflection.zh: 微观寄生虫移动和生存所需的精确性令人惊叹，这涉及一系列协调的化学信号。随着科学家揭示弓形虫等生物中甲基化这一“看不见”的机制，我们被提醒，生命的任何部分都不是偶然的。这些发现邀请我们去惊叹雅伟编织在生物界中的深奥智慧，即使是最小的生物也以有目的的设计在运行。
